title: Vapouriz 50/50 Grape 10ml
description: Vapouriz 50/50 Grape is the ultimate grape e-liquid, bursting with ripe, fresh, juicy Red and Black grape flavour, with a smooth, sweet inhale and a gentle sourness on the exhale that will leave your tastebuds begging for more. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full Vapouriz 50/50 E-Liquid collection and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit, Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit. We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options. What Is 50/50 E Liquid? 50/50 e-liquid is called so because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. For more information, Check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide.
